Subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA / SOC2) - Elara Health

Hi Priya / John —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery so we can make the right recommendation for your deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private):

Summary of requirements we heard
- You will process PHI for clinical workflows (patient identifiers + clinical notes) -> BAA required
- SOC2 Type 2 evidence required for vendor security program; procurement will request report and control descriptions
- Audit requirements: 6+ months of immutable audit logs, exportable for audits; ability to provide traceability for access/changes
- Data residency: US-only; customer-managed VPC is preferred but not strictly required if isolation/controls meet requirements
- Key management: customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) requested for critical data-at-rest encryption

Recommended short-list and tradeoffs
1) Hosted API + BAA (fastest onboarding)
   - Pros: fastest time-to-value, fully managed (no infra for you to run)
   - Cons: logical multi-tenancy; we offer BAA + SOC2 Type 2 attestation but limited physical isolation compared to Dedicated/Private
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) + optional VPC peering
   - Pros: strong isolation, predictable throughput, supports customer KMS; typically lower risk profile for enterprise security teams
   - Cons: longer lead time (6-8 weeks provisioning), minimum commitment
3) Private (VPC / on-prem)
   - Pros: maximum isolation, meets strict regulatory/audit requirements where complete network control is needed
   - Cons: longest lead time (8-12 weeks), additional ops responsibilities for your infra team

Requested artifacts / evidence we can provide (attached)
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (full report, control narrative)
- Redwood_HIPAA_BAA_Draft.docx (BAA template we can provision)
- deployment-matrix.csv (matrix mapping controls to deployment modes)

Proposed next steps
- Please confirm whether you want to try Hosted API under BAA (fastest) or if you prefer Dedicated/Private for isolation.
- Security POC: assign whom from your team for a technical deep dive (log formats, KMS flow, audit exports).
- I can schedule a 60-minute architecture + security deep dive the week of Aug 24 to walk engineers through logs, key flow, and control mappings.
- Procurement: I'll upload the BAA + SOC2 to DocuSign / HubSpot after we confirm scope.

Happy to tighten any of the above — thanks again, and I'll follow up with the SOC2 and BAA docs now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A couple quick clarifications so procurement and security can triage: 

1) SOC2 scope: does the attached SOC2 cover the hosted API offering (the one you showed today) or only Redwood's control plane? We need confirmation that the generating endpoints are in-scope.
2) BAA: please confirm whether the standard BAA covers Hosted API usage for PHI or if we must go Dedicated/Private. Our default preference is hosted if the controls and KMS support meet requirements.
3) Audit logs: can you confirm export format (JSON / CSV), retention options (we need 1 year immutable exports), and whether logs include per-request token-level identifiers we can map back to user actions?
4) Timeline: if we decide Dedicated, what is the expected provisioning lead time and any minimum term? Procurement will want to map to our budget cycle.

Can you also share a network diagram for Dedicated vs Hosted that shows where keys live and how traffic flows (a simple PNG or diagram in the doc is fine).

Thanks — looping in procurement@elarahealth.com for budget/timing.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Director, Information Security | Elara Health

Hi Priya — thanks for the questions, answers inline below and additional artifacts attached.

1) SOC2 scope
- The attached Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf is a full SOC2 Type 2 report covering our production control environment, including the Hosted API endpoints (we list the inference API and control plane components in the scope page). I've highlighted the sections (page 6-9) that specifically call out API endpoints and change management controls. If you want, we can produce a short SOC2 summary memo that maps the API endpoints to your audit controls.

2) BAA coverage for Hosted API
- Short answer: Hosted API can be used under a signed BAA. Our standard BAA supports PHI on Hosted as long as customers accept the standard SLA and usage patterns (we require no prohibited data processing patterns). For customers requiring stricter isolation, Dedicated or Private is recommended.

3) Audit logs
- Export format: JSON (primary) and CSV (exportable)
- Retention: configurable; defaults to 90 days in the platform, but we support customer-configured retention up to 13 months with immutable export snapshots for audit (we can provide S3 export runs or periodic signed snapshots).
- Per-request metadata: logs include request id, model variant, timestamp, caller_id, route_id, and token counts. We can map caller_id to your internal user ids when you provide the mapping.

4) Timeline / provisioning
- Dedicated: typical provisioning 6-8 weeks from contract signature (includes capacity reservation, VPC peering setup, certificate provisioning, and KMS integration). Minimum monthly commit applies; I can share the commitment tiers in procurement follow-up.
- Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem): 8-12 weeks depending on network approvals and ops readiness. We provide an installers package + runbook; on-prem has additional support overhead.

Network & key flow diagram
- I attached deployment-matrix.csv which contains a simplified matrix and I'll upload a short network diagram PDF to the HubSpot deal record this afternoon. For Hosted: keys can be customer-managed via KMS (we support AWS KMS customer master keys via cross-account grants) — payloads are encrypted at rest and TLS in transit. For Dedicated/Private: you can bring your own KMS or use HSM integrations for additional assurance.

Next steps
- I'll: (1) upload the SOC2 excerpt and BAA to DocuSign this afternoon, (2) schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive the week of Aug 24, and (3) share Dedicated commitment tiers and the procurement checklist (DocuSign link included below).
- Please confirm the security POC and preferred time window for the week of Aug 24.

DocuSign (BAA & procurement checklist): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/xxxxxxxx
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ELR-2026-092

If you want a shorter call just focused on logs/KMS, we can do 30 minutes this coming Thu.

Best,
